slides.1.title: 🍯 The Six Prädikat Tiers Explained
slides.1.items.0.text: Kabinett: normal harvest, lightest style, 8–9% alcohol, fresh and easy-drinking
slides.1.items.1.text: Spätlese (late harvest): over-ripe pick, rich and rounded, sweet or Trocken
slides.1.items.2.text: Auslese (selected): hand-picked ripe bunches; can show noble rot influence; complex and sweet
slides.1.items.3.text: Beerenauslese (BA): berry-by-berry selection; noble rot required; lusciously sweet with honey
slides.1.items.4.text: Eiswein: harvested naturally frozen; concentrated sweetness and acidity; extremely rare
slides.1.items.5.text: Trockenbeerenauslese (TBA): shrivelled berry-by-berry selection — the ultimate sweet wine

slides.4.title: Quick Quiz
slides.4.questions.0.question: What is the special harvest condition for Eiswein?
slides.4.questions.0.options.1: Picked while naturally frozen on the vine
slides.4.questions.0.options.3: Picked at the latest possible ripeness
slides.4.questions.0.explanation: Eiswein must be harvested while the grapes are naturally frozen on the vine (typically below −8°C). The frozen water remains crystallised in the press, so only the concentrated sweet juice is extracted — yielding very high residual sugar and equally high acidity.
slides.4.questions.1.question: Which Prädikat level does NOT require noble rot (Botrytis)?
slides.4.questions.1.explanation: Eiswein concentration relies entirely on freezing temperatures and does not require noble rot. In fact, healthy grapes are preferred for Eiswein because Botrytis damages the cell structure and reduces the freezing effect.
slides.4.questions.2.question: On the 'qmp-sweetness' ladder, the key feature of TBA (Trockenbeerenauslese) harvesting is?
slides.4.questions.2.explanation: TBA is made from berries shrivelled by noble rot (Botrytis), individually hand-picked. Through repeated selective passes the water content is concentrated to the maximum, reaching 150–154 °Oe and beyond. The wines are entirely hand-harvested, golden in colour, and capable of ageing 50+ years.
